final_answer:
DTI: 28.17% — under 50% DU limit (B3-6-02).  
Funds to close: $184,368 (down payment $165,000 + closing costs $19,368).  
Available funds: bank balance $129,244 + gift $84,000 = $213,244.  
Reserves: 7.43 months — exceeds 2-month requirement for second home (B3-4.1-01).  
LTV: 75% — ≤80%, so no minimum borrower contribution required for second home (B3-4.3-04).

Critical issue: Gift donor is an "interested party." B3-4.3-04 states "The donor may not be, or have any affiliation with, the builder, the developer, the real estate agent, or any other interested party to the transaction." Gift from interested party is not allowed. Without the gift, borrower has only $129,244 — $55,124 short of cash to close. A condition cannot cure this (no additional funds or different donor permitted).

DECISION: decline  
RULES: B3-4.3-04
